en: A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard laid out in a cross pattern. Four rectangular photos surround an oval central image. The top-left shows a wooden pier with boats and buildings labeled "Bryggan." The top-right shows a large school building flying a Nordic-style flag, labeled "Västkustens Ungdomsskola." The center oval depicts a church with a tall steeple by the water, labeled "Ljungs kyrka." The bottom-left image shows a fjord landscape and shoreline buildings labeled "Ljungs kilefjorden." The bottom-right shows a general view of a small coastal town labeled "Ljungkile." The words "Hälsning från Ljungskile" (Greetings from Ljungskile) are printed across the middle.
